# Skein

> Skein is a tiny zero-dependency, HTML-first Web Components runtime with fine-grained reactivity and native component composition.

Current runtime: Skein 0.5. Production entry: `skein.min.js` — 14.5 kB raw, 5.3 kB gzip, 4.8 kB Brotli. No virtual DOM, npm dependency or required build step.

Important code-generation rules: keep static/semantic/SEO-critical content in ordinary HTML; use Skein for interactive regions. Bindings inside `{...}` are property paths. Use `computed()` for derived state, stable `key={id}` for application lists, `@event={handler}` for events, and `onCleanup()` / `abortSignal` for owned resources.

Component composition uses browser semantics: owner-to-child data goes through DOM properties such as `.volume={volume}`; the child declares a reactive property with `this.volume = input('volume', fallback)`; child-to-owner communication uses native bubbling/composed `CustomEvent`. Do not invent framework stores or an event bus merely for component communication.

Public module API: `Skein.version` and `Skein.define(tag, source)`. Component-script helpers: `input`, `computed`, `effect`, `onCleanup`, `host`, `abortSignal`. Do not use removed v0.4-era low-level APIs such as `batch`, `signal`, `untrack`, `Skein.stats` or `Skein.flush`.

## Start

- [60-second start](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/start/): one-file `<template skein>` app with no npm or build step.
- [README](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/blob/main/README.md): framework overview, composition contract, rendering model, lifecycle, build and tests.

## Reference

- [Documentation](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/docs/): human-readable Skein 0.5 reference.
- [Full LLM context](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/llms-full.txt): complete compact machine-oriented syntax and architecture model.
- [AI and agents](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/ai/): agent entry point.

## Examples

- [Examples](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/examples/): live applications plus Skein Studio, a multi-file composition of transport, sequencer, synth, mixer and Canvas scope.
- [Playground](https://pom4h.github.io/web-component/playground/): zero-dependency editor for single component files with sandboxed live preview.

## Agent resources

- [Agent Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pom4H/web-component/main/.agents/skills/skein/SKILL.md): portable Skein coding instructions.
- [Repository instructions](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for modifying the framework itself.

## Source

- [Runtime source](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/tree/main/runtime): fine-grained reactivity, compiler, composition inputs and lifecycle.
- [Studio composition](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/tree/main/examples/studio): real tag-to-file component composition using properties down and CustomEvents up.
- [Production build](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/blob/main/tools/build.mjs): zero-dependency bundler/minifier for `skein.min.js`.
- [Tests](https://github.com/Pom4H/web-component/tree/main/test): Node + real-Chrome zero-dependency test suite.
